text:
emma: EU-central canary flagged by deploy-bot for SBOM mismatch on telemetry-agent:5.0.2. Change window ~4h. Options: emergency hotpatch to remove the telemetry collector, regional carveout, or rollback to 5.0.1?

deploy-bot: GATE FAILED - sbom_mismatch for registry.redwood/telemetry/telemetry-agent:5.0.2. Canary halted in eu-central. Suggested actions: rollback to 5.0.1, pin region to 5.0.1, or ship hotpatch that disables optional collector at runtime.

oliver: Release lead here. Prefer hotpatch that disables the collector via env flag (fast revertable) so we don't lose other fixes in 5.0.2. I can push a hotpatch image 5.0.2-hp1 built from CI without the collector enabled. ETA ~45m.

security: Security: hotpatch ok provided we attach SBOM and cosign within 24h and create remediation ticket SEC-2026-0175. Also require explicit rollback triggers and owner.

legal: Legal: we'll allow 24h regional carveout/hotpatch if security confirms mitigation and release-note language is included. Customer transparency required.

sara: QA: will run focused functional and telemetry smoke. If we see missing metrics or >0.5% user errors, cut traffic. Also watch for gaps in observability.

ops: Ops: hotpatch route sounds safe. Ensure feature-flag toggle to enable collector later and validate rolling restart strategy for eu-central shards. We'll hold at 5% traffic until QA green.

emma: Rollback criteria: (1) user-facing 5xx >0.5% sustained 10m, (2) missing critical metrics across >2 metric families for 15m, (3) p99 latency increase >200ms across two 5-min windows. Owner: oliver oncall 12h. I'll add to PR and release notes.

oliver: Commands I'll run and include in PR for audit:

```
# patch env var to disable collector and tag hotpatch
kubectl -n prod-eu-central set env deployment/telemetry-agent DISABLE_COLLECTOR=true --record
# build/push hotpatch image (CI)
# CI will tag as 5.0.2-hp1 and attach SBOM; pushing to registry then updating manifest
sed -i 's/telemetry-agent:5.0.2/telemetry-agent:5.0.2-hp1/' k8s/releases/canary-eu-central.yaml && git commit -am "hotpatch: disable collector for eu-central canary"
```

security-bot: temporary-hotpatch-request APPROVED by @security with 24h remediation SLA. Logged SEC-2026-0175. Conditions: SBOM + cosign attach within SLA, remediation ticket open. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: action=hotpatch eu-central apply image=telemetry-agent:5.0.2-hp1. Canary will resume after manifest merge. Audit log created.

emma: Thanks. @legal please add blurb to release notes; @oliver ping when PR merged and QA starts.

legal: Added: "eu-central temporary hotpatch (5.0.2-hp1) to disable optional telemetry collector due to SBOM mismatch; security remediation ticket SEC-2026-0175 opened. Hotpatch valid 24h pending SBOM/cosign verification"

oliver: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4765  smoke at 5% traffic. Will update if metrics cross rollback thresholds. :rocket:
